$comment: MB-31 Layer 3 catalogue, scripts/seeds/bylaw/layer3-catalogue.json, copied from the stage 2 draft plus the L31-14 input_flags on storeys_max (plan section 18) (M-377). Increment 1 only. Scratch evidence: the build copies it, the loop proves it. No by-law number appears in any expression: every figure is read through l2(), lv(), a declared geometry input or a declared fact input. Literals are 0, 1, 2 only (R-KN). Increment 2 (MB-27): the main-wall share caps and both roof forms (M-457), rows marked "increment":"2"; an increment-1 row with an increment-2 formula carries it in "revisions", behind its own switch, and a switched-off revision reverts to the increment-1 formula (M-476).
